meta.title: Add a Creator column (e.g. Price Cap) and fill it as buyer

plan.title: Add and fill a Creator column

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow.
Provide the required event title for a create test.
Configure the event as an RFQ so the pricing sheet is the subject under test.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding line items or columns.
Add the line item needed for the sheet column to have editable cells.
Verify that the first column-category menu offers exactly Creator and Participant.
Verify the Creator list contains all six required column options.
Select a representative Creator column from the required list.
Verify that the selected Creator column is visible on the RFQ sheet.

args.goal: as the buyer, fill the first row of the new Price Cap column with a valid value and stop on the RFQ sheet showing the entered value retained

steps.note: Fill the newly added Creator column using the buyer session; the test case does not specify a particular value.
Confirm the populated sheet still shows the selected Creator column header.
